title: Electronic services

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Distinguish a static map from an interactive service so people receive the interaction and information they need.
strategic_value: Choosing the appropriate map integration can keep Helsinki digital services coherent with their purpose.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture lists screenshot, embedded-map and geospatial-interface routes in increasing implementation complexity.
practical_value: Choose screenshot, Export/Share embed or data interface according to whether the map must be static, interactive or integrated.

content_islands.name: Three delivery routes
content_islands.spec: Keep the acquisition choices in a sequential bullet list with interface contacts attached to the final option.

reference_purposes.Application: The section explains screenshots, Export/Share embeds and interface-based map use.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It states that using a geospatial data interface requires an agreement with City Survey Services.
